tool_args.rationale: The expanded gradient range is informative, while outputs remain positive and concave. Fit the two-parameter sink-inhibited saturating siphon base law to all observations; the open-branch data do not require an additive branch term.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observations are all at one horizon and fixed x/memory; an ODE trajectory batch is costly and not needed for the observed monotone saturating response.
The shape is concave from low inputs onward, unlike a Hill-2 curve's low-input convex rise.
A more flexible four-parameter activation law is not warranted by the smooth concave input response; defer unless confirmation indicates systematic residuals.
